sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup safe is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 3x3 grid loot container that spawns weapons, grenades, paper ammo boxes, grenade launcher cartridges, medical supplies, medical items, tools, flammable materials, info items and TerraGroup Labs access keycards.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: In the TerraGroup storage room on Factory.
